certificateLevels.meaning: Correctness, security, privacy, identity, lifecycle, resource and durability invariants.
A small preregistered endpoint family that represents one bounded technical claim.
Secondary performance, efficiency and distribution diagnostics.
Oracle regret, model checking, alternative policies and exploratory distribution models.

distributionDiagnostics.extremeValueTheory: Research sensitivity analysis only until threshold selection, dependence, goodness-of-fit and threshold uncertainty are preregistered and validated.
distributionDiagnostics.stochasticDominance: Use directional dominance inference with dependence-aware block subsampling; a visual ECDF or ordinary equality KS test is insufficient.
distributionDiagnostics.wasserstein: Report unit-preserving or preregistered-normalized W1 with block-bootstrap uncertainty; W1 alone does not identify which tail or user-visible endpoint improved.

metricOrientation.canonicalLoss: Every quantitative endpoint declares direction and is transformed to a loss for which lower is better.
metricOrientation.prohibition: Raw point estimates with mixed higher-is-better and lower-is-better orientation cannot enter claim logic.

policyChangeRule: Changing endpoint membership, margins, gate order or scope after formal results invalidates claim eligibility until the affected experiment is rerun.

bestWithinScope: all L1 hard gates for the scope pass
the dominant-within-scope engineering target passes for every opened L2 family in the certificate
no L2 primary endpoint in the scope is merely equivalent, noninferior, inferior, or inconclusive unless a preregistered optimal-floor proof applies
the exact evidence scope and all digests are machine emitted
scopeCertificate.coParetoFrontier: L3 endpoints may establish non-domination or a shared Pareto frontier, but cannot override an L1 failure or manufacture an L2 best claim.
noninferiorWithinScope: all L1 hard gates for the scope pass
every L2 primary endpoint is equivalent or noninferior after correction
dominantWithinScope: all L1 hard gates for the scope pass
every applicable L2 primary endpoint is substantially superior to every eligible comparator after correction, or is proven saturated at its mathematical or contractual optimum
the lower confidence bound exceeds the preregistered dominance margin for every non-saturated primary endpoint
no applicable primary endpoint is merely equivalent, noninferior, inferior, or inconclusive
at least eighty percent of applicable L3 secondary endpoints are substantially superior and none is materially inferior
the exact evidence scope and all digests are machine emitted

statisticalDecision.equivalence: TOST confidence interval entirely inside preregistered [-delta,+delta]
statisticalDecision.estimand: preregistered paired run/session-block effect on canonical loss
statisticalDecision.multipleComparisons: hierarchical gatekeeping across claim families, then Holm correction within each opened endpoint family
statisticalDecision.nonInferiority: one-sided confidence bound inside preregistered noninferiority margin
statisticalDecision.power: Each L2 family preregisters target power, maximum inconclusive budget and sample-size escalation rule before formal data.
statisticalDecision.resampling: paired run-session-cluster bootstrap; request/frame observations are never treated as independent replicates
statisticalDecision.superiority: confidence interval excludes zero in the favorable direction and exceeds the preregistered meaningful effect
statisticalDecision.tailQuantiles: p95/p99 endpoints use run-block or moving-block quantile inference with a preregistered minimum tail sample count
statisticalDecision.substantialSuperiority: Holm-adjusted superiority plus a confidence interval whose favorable lower bound exceeds the preregistered dominance margin

engineeringDominanceTarget.strongestComparatorRule: passing every eligible comparator implies passing the strongest observed comparator; comparator removal after results is forbidden
